## Overview
Live tests for Birko.Data.EventSourcing.MongoDB. They run the shared event store contract
(`tests/Shared/EventSourcing/EventStoreContract.cs`, TASK-995) on `MongoDBEventStore`, obtained the way an application
does: `factory.GetEventStore(o => o.AddMongoDB())`. The contract runs once on a replica set (the transaction path) and
once on a standalone server (the default path).

## Project Location
`tests/Birko.Data.EventSourcing.MongoDB.Tests/`

## Test Framework
xUnit + FluentAssertions

## Scope & conventions
- `MongoDBReplicaSetEventStoreContractTests` is gated on `BIRKO_MONGO_HOST` / `BIRKO_MONGO_PORT`, the replica set every
  MongoDB suite uses (CI's `live-tests.yml` runs this project).
- `MongoDBStandaloneEventStoreContractTests` is gated on `BIRKO_MONGO_STANDALONE_URL` (locally `mongodb://localhost:27018/`).
  CI's live-tests MongoDB job starts one on port 27018 and sets it (since TASK-1000).
- Each test class instance uses its own database (`birko_task995_<guid>`) and drops it on dispose.
- `NewStoreAsync()` builds a new factory each call, so the concurrency tests race two clients.

## Coverage
- On both servers: the 9 contract tests, and the override chosen for a MongoDB factory (the default store without it).
- On the replica set: an append inside the caller's `MongoDbUnitOfWork` is undone when the caller rolls back.
- On the standalone server: `MongoDBStandaloneCrashedBatchTests` (TASK-1000), the 6 tests of
  `tests/Shared/EventSourcing/CrashedBatchContract.cs`, the dying writer being a `MongoDBEventStore` over
  `CrashingMongoDBStore` (database `birko_task1000_<guid>`).
